test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

None of the boys was __willing to admit__ that he was in the wrong.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'No substitution required'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is **grammatically correct.**
 
• Here, everything is used properly.
 
• We know that after '**to**' **infinitive** the **base form of the verb** (**admit**) is used.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *None of the boys was willing to admit that he was in the wrong.*
